metadata.title: Vintage Country Music Portrait Album Cover

retrievalProfile.description: A watercolor-style portrait of a musician in a cowboy hat set against a textured, warm-toned background with bold, top-aligned sans-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, painterly portrait of a man wearing a black cowboy hat and a white jacket over a yellow shirt, positioned against a mottled reddish-pink and purple watercolor wash background. Bold yellow sans-serif text spans the top, while secondary decorative text is clustered in the upper right.
coreVisualRelationships: The yellow shirt collar echoes the color of the primary headline text.
The dark cowboy hat provides a high-contrast anchor against the soft background.
The subject's gaze is directed slightly off-center, creating a personal connection.
coreInvariants: Mottled watercolor texture in the background
Bold yellow sans-serif headline at the top edge
Hand-painted illustrative style for the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered and occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame, cropped at the chest.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The black cowboy hat serves as the primary visual anchor due to its dark value and central placement.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold yellow headline, moves down to the face, and then to the secondary text in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper corners and the area around the head provide breathing room through textured watercolor washes.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm reddish-pink and purple watercolor wash background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black hat and white jacket provide value contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow used for the shirt and the primary typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the yellow and background tones, with deep shadows in the hat and facial features.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm earth tones and primary yellow

letterConstructionRules: Slightly rounded corners on the exterior of curves
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair bold sans-serif with a secondary decorative serif or script for metadata.

avoid: Serif fonts for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and condensed nature of the display text.
Provides a similar vintage editorial feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a watercolor-style portrait of a man in a black cowboy hat and white jacket against a mottled red and purple background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold yellow condensed sans-serif text at the top center of the image.

verificationChecks: Is the main text bright yellow and bold?
Is the subject wearing a cowboy hat?

mustAchieve: Strong color coordination between text and subject

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the background
Confirm the yellow saturation matches the shirt
recipe.reuseFormula: Watercolor portrait + bold condensed sans-serif headline + warm mottled background.
